```plato
//==
// # Easing
//
// Easing functions shape the rate of change of an animated value: pure maps from
// normalized time in [0, 1] to normalized progress. Progress is nominally in
// [0, 1], but the Back and Elastic families intentionally overshoot. Keyframes,
// tweens, and transitions select easings by ClassicEasing or carry one of the
// parameterized easing records declared here.

// The family (base shape) of a non-linear classic easing curve.
type EasingFamily
    = Quad | Cubic | Quart | Quint | Sine | Expo | Circ | Back | Elastic | Bounce;
```
